### A Firm and Flawless Foundation
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-may-10-2016.html
Passage: Psalm 12:6
Points:
- Believers often feel lonely and exhausted when surrounded by dishonesty and faithlessness.
- Like biblical figures before him, David honestly poured out his frustrations to the Lord.
- David intentionally transitioned from lamenting human deceit to praising the righteousness of God.
- Unlike shifting human promises, God's Word stands completely pure, tested, and reliable.
- Trusting in Christ as our flawless cornerstone anchors us amidst a broken culture.

### Save, O Lord
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-24-2023.html
Passage: Psalm 12:1
Points:
- Being God's child does not insulate believers from the pain of living among corrupt people.
- Surrounded by flattery, lies, and celebrated vileness, David chose prayer as his first reaction.
- Scripture models turning away from grumbling, rage, or despair in difficult environments.
- Bringing urgent pleas to God demonstrates ongoing trust and allegiance to Christ alone.
- Believers are called to pray and obey, confident that the faithful Lord will preserve them.
